aj: heads up — canary rollout for tokenizer-remap v5.8 is showing p99 latency jump on serving nodes in eu-west-1 :eyes:
kevin: rough numbers?
aj: p50 ~ 70ms (baseline 60), p99 jumped from ~120ms -> ~420ms for the canary slice. throughput down ~12%. KV cache hitrate for canary tenants dropped from 0.85 -> 0.42
maria: that KV hit drop is huge. did the tokenizer remap increase subtoken counts?
aj: yes, quick diff shows average encoded tokens +42% for our test prompts. new merges changed some sml tokens -> multiple subtokens.
sophia: profiler snapshot attached (short text):
```
kernel_decider: chosen=quant_fallback_v2 seq_len=980 enc_tokens=1378 kv_hit=0.40
batcher: batch_size=8 avg_seq=980 tail_pct=5 p99_latency_ms=418
kv_cache: prefix_hits=0.15 total_hits=0.42 eviction_rate_up=3x
```
aj: also seeing kernel selector choose the slower quant fallback because enc_tokens > fast_kernel_seq_threshold (configured 1024) — but because tokenization exploded, many seqs crossed threshold
kevin: runtime-bot shows canary deploy at 3245678800 by deploy-bot. so this is immediate post-deploy regression
runtime-bot: deploy completed: service=runtime-canary image=tokenizer-remap:v5.8 slice=canary
ops-bot: alerted: latency_p99_alert on cluster-eu-west-1
maria: quick mitigation: can we pin canary to force fast_kernel for a subset? or rollback?
kevin: two short options: 1) rollback canary (fast) 2) temporary override: bump fast_kernel_seq_threshold to 1600 for canary nodes to avoid fallback (risky)
sophia: bumping threshold might hide true perf path for long sequences — but it buys time. also we could enable more aggressive prefix prefetch to warm KV cache for affected prefixes
aj: I can trigger rollback now if we want to stop user impact. OR we try threshold bump + kv prefetch for 15m to see effect and then rollback if no improvement
maria: how many tenants in the canary? small slice (~3% of traffic) — some customer-facing pages hit p99 hard though
kevin: i'd prefer rollback then iterate in staging. we need regression tests for token distribution changes in CI
sophia: agreed. also open PR to add a tokenization distribution check to rollout gating: PR #4123 (wip)
aj: rolling back canary nowuntime-bot: rolling back: deploy start image=tokenizer-remap:v5.7 -> status=initiated by aj
kevin: after rollback, let's collect a before/after perf trace and KV stats and add a short blameless postmortem
maria: action items: (1) rollback completed (aj) (2) add unit/regression test for avg_subtokens and seq_len tail in rollout gating (maria) (3) explore kernel decider change to consider encoded token delta not raw seq len (kevin) (4) add temporary canary profiling hook to auto-capture kv/cache/decider when p99 > threshold (sophia)
aj: rollback finished — p99 back to baseline within two minutes :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident closed: latency_p99_alert resolved by rollback
sophia: follow-up: i'll file a small RFC on tokenization-aware routing and kernel-decider changes, and we'll run the tokenizer-remap in a larger synthetic suite before next canary
kevin: thanks team. postmortem notes: short, include sample tokenization diffs, kernel-decider trace, and test coverage plan
aj: will paste logs and flamegraph link in the incident doc shortly
maria: nice quick response. let's not ship more tokenization changes without the distribution check added to gating. :+1:
